1.consolidated_definition: "Acusar": persona que denuncia o imputa a alguien la comisión de un delito o falta, generalmente ante las autoridades competentes.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Accuser: a person who reports or accuses someone of committing a crime or offense, typically to the relevant authorities.
